snp5.16:1.3: but the Visionary did not answer me,
snp5.16:1.4: if (asked) up to a third time the Divine Seer answers, I have heard.
snp5.16:2.2: the Brahma world with its Gods:
snp5.16:2.3: one does not know what view of this the reputable Gotama has.
snp5.16:3.1: So, to the One With Excellent Sight,
snp5.16:3.2: I have come in need with a question:
snp5.16:3.3: Looking on the world in what way does the king of Death not see (one)?
snp5.16:4.1: “Look on the world as empty, Mogharāja,
snp5.16:4.4: in this way one will cross beyond Death.
snp5.16:4.5: When looking on the world in this way the king of Death does not see (one).”
